wreckNames: FM-038, on the chart: the pre-commit hook hides the suites' skip lines: a test that skips by name is never seen at commit time
FM-037, salvage under way: a seat can change the Owner's intent and current path in TRIAGE.md, and the gate lets it through
FM-036, raised: A worksheet with two filled rows for one tracker applies both in order, so every run flips the rank
FM-035, raised: CI is red on the v0.18.3 release tag: two suites fail on Windows and one traceback on macOS while Ubuntu is green
FM-034, raised: A fresh clone's --check says the INDEX is stale: the header carries the clone's own finding
FM-033, salvage under way: Work is built on trackers no pass has judged, and the board shows the person that work as waiting for triage
FM-030, salvage under way: An accepted action ask leaves the person's list before the act is done
FM-029, salvage under way: The answer says accepted when the person picked an option other than the proposal
FM-028, on the chart: After midnight the suite refuses every commit: the board and the tool count days by different clocks
FM-018, on the chart: The answer flow must be convenient and fail-safe for a normal user
FM-007, salvage under way: A signature proves the key, not the hand — an agent running as the Owner on his machine signs as him
FM-009, raised: __version__ has drifted from VERSION, and --vendor suppresses the changelog because of it
FM-010, raised: The answerers deprecation warning never reaches the repositories still on answerers alone
FM-011, raised: Vendoring from an incomplete source copies what it finds and pins only that, instead of refusing
FM-012, raised: A load spawns git once per tracker, and --answer is silent for a minute
FM-013, raised: After OK the answer dialog leaves only abort, and says nothing about signing
FM-014, raised: The seat cannot record that it acted on an answer: clearing is refused as an answer change
FM-015, raised: [seats] silently drops a signature that answerers asked for
FM-016, closed: An answered ask still shows as unanswered on the branch the Owner returns to
FM-017, raised: A failed --answer leaves its writes behind, and the next --answer cannot say why it refuses
FM-019, raised: A merge commit is judged as the merger's own change, and main's --check goes red on every merge
FM-020, raised: Searching the board for a whole id shows every tracker that links to it
FM-021, raised: The progress section is empty beside work in progress and does not say why
FM-022, raised: A person finds the three intent lines hard to start — no beginning, no example
canvas: image: A night chart of the German Bight: the East Frisian islands from Borkum to Wangerooge, the Jade, the Weser and the Elbe, the flats and sandbanks between them, Helgoland offshore. Magenta wrecks lie on the flats; each is a defect from shoalmark's own tracker, listed in the wreck register below.
